work.name: Canada West Land
work.summary: Software and AI-focused technologist building internal APIs, production agents, and automation tooling on Azure alongside enterprise geospatial delivery.
highlights: Gave 100 colleagues across 5 roles instant answers from company data by building role-specific AI assistants on Microsoft Foundry, connected to internal APIs and tools; used daily in production.
Built and deployed 3 internal APIs on Azure (Functions, App Service, API Management) serving hundreds of requests daily across 5 teams, shipped through Azure DevOps CI/CD.
Cut selected full-day manual processes to 1–2 hours by helping build an AI workflow app with LangChain, LangGraph, and n8n.
Cut QC time from 2 days to 1 hour on a six-map enterprise GIS workstream (up to 1M records) by automating Python and FME pipelines with AI-assisted methods now standard on the team.

work.name: University of Calgary
work.summary: Led capstone delivery and built the Python processing and validation pipeline comparing survey methods against photogrammetry-derived spatial datasets.

work.name: Gongcha
work.summary: Ran high-volume shift operations and trained new staff on standardized workflows.

projects.name: UBC Department of Psychology Research Platform
highlights: Built solo as the official study platform for a UBC Psychology cognitive research lab, now also run with Yonsei University in Seoul.
Research assistants use it to run live study sessions; 180+ participants so far, with questionnaires scored automatically (Next.js, FastAPI, Supabase).

projects.name: Glass Atlas: AI-Powered Personal Blog
highlights: Personal blog where readers can ask questions in a chat and get answers drawn from my posts, with links back to the source.
Built with SvelteKit and PostgreSQL; a RAG search layer finds posts by meaning as well as keywords so answers stay accurate.

projects.name: PigeonCoop: Visual Workflow Builder for AI Coding Agents
highlights: Desktop app for building, running, and replaying AI coding-agent workflows on a visual canvas, with human-review checkpoints.
Built in Rust and React; every run is recorded so it can be replayed step by step.

projects.name: Cloo: Terminal Workspace for AI Coding Agents
highlights: Open-source Rust terminal app, similar to tmux, for running several AI coding agents side by side.
Sessions keep running in the background after the window closes and can be picked up again later (pre-alpha).
